optimized_sql:
WITH customer_total_return AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT wr_returning_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk,
           customer_address.ca_state AS ctr_state,
           SUM(wr_return_amt) AS ctr_total_return
    FROM web_returns
    JOIN date_dim ON wr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk
    JOIN customer_address ON wr_returning_addr_sk = ca_address_sk
    WHERE d_year = 2000
    GROUP BY wr_returning_customer_sk, customer_address.ca_state
),
state_avg AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT ctr_state,
           AVG(ctr_total_return) * 1.2 AS ctr_threshold
    FROM customer_total_return
    GROUP BY ctr_state
),
eligible_customers AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT c_customer_id,
           c_salutation,
           c_first_name,
           c_last_name,
           c_preferred_cust_flag,
           c_birth_day,
           c_birth_month,
           c_birth_year,
           c_birth_country,
           c_login,
           c_email_address,
           c_last_review_date_sk,
           c_customer_sk
    FROM (SELECT ca_address_sk
          FROM customer_address
          WHERE ca_state = 'AR') AS ar_addr
    JOIN customer ON ar_addr.ca_address_sk = c_current_addr_sk
)
SELECT e.c_customer_id,
       e.c_salutation,
       e.c_first_name,
       e.c_last_name,
       e.c_preferred_cust_flag,
       e.c_birth_day,
       e.c_birth_month,
       e.c_birth_year,
       e.c_birth_country,
       e.c_login,
       e.c_email_address,
       e.c_last_review_date_sk,
       ctr1.ctr_total_return
FROM eligible_customers e
JOIN customer_total_return ctr1 ON e.c_customer_sk = ctr1.ctr_customer_sk
JOIN state_avg sa ON ctr1.ctr_state = sa.ctr_state
WHERE ctr1.ctr_total_return > sa.ctr_threshold
ORDER BY e.c_customer_id,
         e.c_salutation,
         e.c_first_name,
         e.c_last_name,
         e.c_preferred_cust_flag,
         e.c_birth_day,
         e.c_birth_month,
         e.c_birth_year,
         e.c_birth_country,
         e.c_login,
         e.c_email_address,
         e.c_last_review_date_sk,
         ctr1.ctr_total_return
LIMIT 100

2. 3. 4.
